name: Living Saint’s Shadow
summary: Once per long rest, when you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, or when you fail a death saving throw, you instead stand with 1 hit point, end the prone condition on yourself, and emit a 30-ft aura until the end of your next turn. Allies in the aura gain advantage on attack rolls and saving throws against fear.
